# House-Price-Prediction-AICA-x-DataCamp
## Capstone Project For Machine Learning Cohort:
## Residential Property Price Predictor

# Project Overview
Welcome to the Residential Property Price Predictor capstone. In this project, I developed a supervised machine learning regression model to estimate house prices based on fundamental property attributes. As an extension of the data analytics and AI curriculum designed for real estate applications, this project serves as a practical application of predictive modeling to automate and standardize property valuation processes.
